This '''Neimoidian''' was a historic military commander.

==Biography==
This officer was known to wear a giant hat and rode a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] during a campaign.
He was a significant person in [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] society and was granted a heroic portrait. This artwork came to hang in a gallery within [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was described as a "Napoleonic Neimoidian" in the episode guide. This is in reference to [[Wikipedia:Napoleon|Napoleon Bonaparte]], Emperor of [[Wikipedia:France|France]], whom the Neimoidien resembles. The painting itself is a reference to the classical portrait [[Wikipedia:Napoleon Crossing the Alps|''Napoleon Crossing the Alps'']] by [[Wikipedia:Jacques-Louis David|Jacques-Louis David]].<ref name="EG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
